Unbalanced

You meet the obstacle with everything you are, and let it discover whether that is enough.

Rules

Agreed: minimum 0 in Brawn, Fortitude; HP contribution +6. No multiclassing.

Starting disciplines: choose two distinct rank-1 disciplines from Arms, Athletics, Armor, Storm.

Discipline pricing: Home: Arms, Athletics. Adjacent: Armor, Storm. All others Foreign; no Opposed disciplines.

Choose one class-exclusive signature at levels 1, 3 and 7. Extra signatures cost 2/4/8 DP. No discipline requirements.

Level 1 choices

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.7f2ba854775959a6.JournalEntryPage.af55105b197150ac]{Shoulder Through} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.1bf051718758c7fe.JournalEntryPage.8bc4b44cdce81cc2]{Wild Approach} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.48cd261644939ea1.JournalEntryPage.2235d9d629bdf783]{Laugh at the Fall}

Level 3 choices

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.fecbbf9d78302b72.JournalEntryPage.5db2fddba6f81b60]{Crush the Barrier} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.3a1e3de9d46d3b70.JournalEntryPage.e9168c06d057c389]{Fling the Captive} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.c99eeb1e08b8580e.JournalEntryPage.5f9cbd9c8173c271]{Raging Recoil}

Level 7 choices

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.f44ab2a64cb38396.JournalEntryPage.9ab790a370aa6234]{Scatter the Line} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.c05357a0d31771e8.JournalEntryPage.025ae9d7d636a4cf]{Break Their Grip} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.a6466d7dc5fccff4.JournalEntryPage.d8059370a29fdd0a]{Crash Down}

Signature identity in play

The revised options aim for these moments, with a deliberate advantage over shared cards of their tier. Each is an independent choice, not a progression chain.

- Level 1: Drive through, charge, or rise fighting. - Level 3: Break an obstruction, throw a creature, or shove back through pain. - Level 7: Scatter enemies, wrench free and retaliate, or finish a push with a knockdown.

Starting coin contribution: +0 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
